verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Datadog ships Log Management, APM/tracing, OpenTelemetry ingestion and Dashboards. A customer reports that it correlates APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging and that these are densely linked across the platform, which covers the core of the story. One critic calls the correlation weaker than Honeycomb or Dynatrace, but that is a comparative opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of metrics collection and of cross-signal pivoting with shared context (e.g., unified tagging or trace-to-log linking); hands-on evidence of pivoting between metrics, logs and traces.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Datadog's main advantage is correlating data across APM, custom metrics and logs via tagging, densely linked across the platform
